{{Otheruses|Warehouse district}}
The '''warehouse district''' was located on the southwest side of [[Iritsa]]. It was full of large buildings for storage of cargo that could not be immediately delivered to its destination. The streets were very congested with large [[Skiff/Legends|skiffs]] which were unloaded by lower class workers who lived in [[The Clog]].

Many of the warehouses were owned by [[Hahz Fallone]].
